reuse.why: Adds the variation as a parameter of the existing shouldFillCategory/getAverageFillCategories selection that every month-wide action already uses.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; only the flag plumbing (default param plus pass-through) repeats across the six actions, which is inherent to the API.

placement.why: The hidden-category decision stays in the shared fill predicate in budget/actions.ts.

scope.why: Only the fill selection, the action signatures and a release note.

maintainability.why: One predicate owns the rule with an explicit includeHidden option, and the requireGroup check was adjusted to keep its own meaning independent of the new flag.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions go through shouldFillCategory.
